notes: The compiler's preface lists three routes to Muhammad b. Hamran; each is written in full
«أبي» (the compiler's father) and «أبيه» (Ali b. Ibrahim's father) name no one: bare relation links
«- رضي اللّه عنه -» and «- رحمه اللّه -» are honorific glosses and are left out
«جميعا» joins Ayyub and Ibrahim at Safwan (rule 3); the third route is read as «و ابن أبي عمير جميعا عن محمد بن حمران»
